label: post-hoc, development data, descriptive, not confirmatory
task: W18 post-hoc case study: where new-item exploration happens, by department and product group

definitions.event: item of a basket from the user's 2nd basket on (distinct items per basket); new-item event when the item is in no earlier basket of the user

levels.coarse: L1 of configs/common.yaml levels (Instacart coarse_category = department, Complete Journey DEPARTMENT)
levels.fine: L2 (Instacart fine_category = aisle, Complete Journey commodity)

definitions.volume: new-item events in c and their share of all new-item events
definitions.propensity: new-item events in c / all events in c
definitions.lift: share of new-item events in c / share of all events in c
definitions.breadth: share of users with >= 1 new-item event in c over all users and over users with >= 1 row in c in any basket of the split
definitions.known_category_share: among new-item events in c, share whose category c was already in the user's earlier baskets
definitions.predictability: target new items of c in the user's top-10 E2 (user-CF) or flat popularity list / target new items of c; E2 slot share = share of all top-10 E2 rows in c; target new share = share of all target new items in c
definitions.bootstrap: users resampled with replacement; ratio-of-sums statistics; 2.5 / 97.5 percentiles

predictability.definition: hit rate = target new items of the category that appear in the user's top-10 list / target new items of the category (item-level new-item recall per category); slot share = share of all top-10 E2 rows whose item is in the category

mismatch.definition: difference = E2 slot share - target new-item share; categories passing the support filter on target new items or holding >= 1 % of the E2 slots
difference = E2 slot share - target new-item share; categories passing the support filter on target new items or holding >= 1 % of the E2 slots

quadrants_fine.definition: fine categories with >= support new target items; rate = new-item rate over all eval events (history + target); high = strictly above the median of the placed categories; lists sorted by target new items
